description: Archived from playable selection due to fewer than 11 verified canonical answers. Relations, entities and evidence remain in curated-bank.json; do not feed these archived questions into matches unless they are revised and pass the 11-answer gate.

questions.prompt: Name a country that won the men’s FIFA World Cup.
questions.hint: Men’s World Cup winners, 1930–2026. West Germany is grouped with Germany.

questions.prompt: Name a London-based club that has played in the Premier League.
questions.hint: Since 1992–93. Clubs based in Greater London during their Premier League seasons.

questions.prompt: Name a club that has won La Liga.
questions.hint: Spanish national top-flight winners from 1929 through 2025–26.

questions.prompt: Name a country that has won the men’s UEFA European Championship.
questions.hint: Champions through Euro 2024. Historical nations count.

questions.prompt: Name a Premier League club that has won the European Cup / Champions League.
questions.hint: A club must have appeared in the Premier League AND lifted Europe’s top men’s club trophy (1992–2026).

questions.prompt: Name a Barcelona player who STARTED both the 2009 and 2011 Champions League finals.
questions.hint: Started against Manchester United in Rome AND at Wembley. Both starting XIs required.

questions.prompt: Name a Bayern Munich player who STARTED both the 2013 and 2020 Champions League finals.
questions.hint: 2013 versus Borussia Dortmund; 2020 versus Paris Saint-Germain. Starting XIs only.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has won BOTH the Premier League Golden Boot and the men’s Ballon d’Or.
questions.hint: Intersection of the reviewed individual winners lists through 2025–26 / 2026.

questions.prompt: Name a men's national team that has won BOTH the FIFA World Cup and UEFA Euro.
questions.hint: Historic European national-team champions; both titles required.

questions.prompt: Name a club that has won BOTH the Bundesliga and the European Cup / Champions League.
questions.hint: Germany's national league since 1963–64 and all-time European Cup champions.

questions.prompt: Name an Italian champion that has ALSO won the European Cup / Champions League.
questions.hint: Both all-time Italian national top-division and European Cup winners.

questions.prompt: Name a Chelsea player who STARTED both the 2008 and 2012 Champions League finals.
questions.hint: Moscow 2008 and Munich 2012 — two starting XIs only.

questions.prompt: Name a Real Madrid player who STARTED both the 2014 and 2017 Champions League finals.
questions.hint: La Décima in Lisbon and victory against Juventus in Cardiff — started both.

questions.prompt: Name a Real Madrid player who STARTED both the 2017 and 2024 Champions League finals.
questions.hint: Cardiff 2017 and Wembley 2024 — only players starting both finals.
